features.summary: Public forms now keep native constraint validation and add a linked, assertive error summary; each invalid field gets an inline error, aria-invalid and aria-describedby; summary links focus the field; correcting input clears stale error state. No request occurs while invalid.

Bound v1 forms can select only existing safe same-page scroll-to/select-tab actions on submit. Buttons cannot use submit; unbound forms have no eligible submit action. The public renderer emits the event only after an accepted service response, so invalid or failed submissions do not run the action. No JavaScript injection, external navigation, extra service, or schema change.
